notes.title: Gun Crazy Is Now Available on Steam! Deathopolis is Coming to Steam in 2020!
notes.content:
[h1]Gun Crazy is a fast paced and hectic arcade style action shoot em’ up, sporting old school pixel art and a retro sound track.[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33066823/eb8c2ae277deb313ff6dc325a244c0757f2c5444.jpg[/img]

Tackle bosses, dodge an onslaught of bullets, and use multiple weapons to take out your foes. Hope you brought your "A" game otherwise be prepared to spam those "continues"!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/897640/Gun_Crazy/


[h1]Deathopolis is an arcade style fast paced shooter. Take on a series of rooms collecting prizes and clearing out waves of enemies using guns and power-up abilities.[/h1]

[list]
[*]     Fast paced arcade action
[*]     Numerous boss fights
[*]     Multiple weapons
[*]     Lots of power ups
[*]     Hordes of enemies
[/list]


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1002820/Deathopolis/
